description: This is a database migration script for adding and removing UUID columns in various tables within the Superset project, using Alembic for schema migrations.

classes.name: ImportMixin
classes.description: A mixin class adding 'id' and 'uuid' columns to models.

methods.name: update_position_json
methods.description: Updates the dashboard's position_json by inserting or removing UUIDs based on a provided map.

methods.name: update_dashboards
methods.description: Iterates over dashboards to update or clean UUIDs in their position_json.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Adds UUID columns to tables, assigns UUIDs, and updates dashboard JSONs.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Removes UUID columns and cleans UUIDs from dashboard JSONs.
